backgrounds.name: the flow
backgrounds.description: The flow of space u (grey arrows) and its acceleration g (dark arrows) round 2 bodies: 1 solar mass at (-7.48e+10, 0) m, 1 solar mass at (7.48e+10, 0) m. Space flows down zero-energy paths out of each body (the eikonal flow, exact for two bodies), so each body has a region of its own; the regions meet at a seam.

layers.label: the seam, where the bodies' regions of flow meet
